messages.author: 93faa92fa04c6a4f
messages.subject: Package ggplot2 not available
parts:
Hi 

 I would like to use the ggplot2 package with Renjin but I cannot load it. I see that 
 http://packages.renjin.org/packages/ggplot2.html  is broken.  Is there any plan to fix this? What should I do to 
 use ggplot from renjin?

-- Leanne

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Package ggplot2 not available
parts:
Hi Leane,
At this time Renjin doesn't support any of the graphics/plotting plumbing of R. It's not currently on the roadmap as at least from our end we use Renjin primarily on the backend of webservices, with js-based visualizations on the frontend, but if you're interested in building some of this out, I'd be happy to point you in the right direction!

Best,
Alex
